source.quote: Best-effort — a slow or down api leaves the menu org-less rather

obligations.statement: When the api is slow or down, the root loader still resolves with an account menu that has no orgs instead of throwing and blanking the whole shell.

source.quote: Registration is access-token gated; authentication is

obligations.statement: The passkey action refuses a passkey registration ceremony from a request that carries no access token.

source.quote: public and ends by exchanging the new session for an access-token cookie.

obligations.statement: A completed passkey authentication ceremony, which needs no prior access token, ends with the action exchanging the new session and setting an access-token cookie.

source.quote: We stash that token in an httpOnly cookie

obligations.statement: The reveal-token action hands the minted reveal token back only as the httpOnly ev_reveal cookie, never in a response body that client JavaScript can read.

source.quote: everything here is token-gated (a signed-in user stepping up).

obligations.statement: The reveal-token action refuses a step-up request that carries no access token, so only a signed-in user can obtain a reveal token.
